summary: Curses a dead, non-Cursed player by Touch; the caster may then heal one wound or instantly Charge an ability.

effects.subject: dead-target
effects.note: No duration given; per the Cursed State it persists after death and is removed on respawn.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: Caster heals one of their own wounds.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: The name of the ability being Charged must be stated immediately after the incantation (N2).
